description: Breaking change, a person's decision: change a field's type, converting the stored values (get_schema lists the types a field can become under `convertibleTo`). Mapled works the conversion out over every record first: if some values can't be converted the request is refused with their count and a few examples — fix the content, or ask again with clearFailed: true to clear those values (the person confirming sees how many). A conversion that would break a formula reading the field is refused too. Nothing changes until a person confirms it on a trusted Mapled screen by typing the field's name (returns a reviewUrl to send to the user); poll get_confirmation. It can be undone from Field settings, with the previous values.

clearFailed.description: Clear the values that can't be converted instead of refusing.

options.description: For enum: the choices; derived from the values when omitted.

type.description: The type to convert to — one of the field's convertibleTo.

name: convert_field
